programs.title: Bamay
programs.sub_title: Noongar Country - The Pinnacles WA Part 2
programs.desc: Explores the stunning land of Noongar Country, with Noongar person Trevor Walley discussing the growth of Aboriginal culture.

programs.title: Toi Time
programs.desc: Jojo, Maia and Tama find out about Tamanuitera and Aunty Anika makes kai with vegetables from her mara.

programs.title: Waabiny Time
programs.desc: Noongar people have been solid tool makers for a long, long time. Karli, the boomerang and kitj, the spear are very useful tools.

programs.title: Birds Eye View
programs.desc: The birds have found some curious and shiny human objects but what on earth are they used for?

programs.title: Aussie Bush Tales
programs.desc: Three mischievous Aboriginal boys and their cousin Jedda always followed by their dingo puppy Snowy, go exploring and investigate new and exciting mysteries in the Aussie Bush.

programs.title: The Mysterious Cities Of Gold
programs.desc: n the desert, Sancho and Pedro who were lost in the dunes are discovered. They finally found their friend Mendoza. In Manfuha, the children try to leave the oasis to reach the Condor.
